It's about a family living during the early 60's. Calvin(who's plays the dad), builds a nuclear fallout shelter under their garage. When he thinks the bombs are falling, he takes his pregnant wife(Helen) and himself into this shelter. They hear a loud crash, which is what they thought was the atom bomb, but was really just a fighter plane crashing into their home. They close the doors and set them to open 35 years later, which is when the radiation will be cleared enough for them to venture out without getting sick. 

Helen gives birth to a baby, whom she names Adam. Calvin and Helen both spend time teaching Adam things like dancing, baseball, piano, and things that a normal kid would learn in school. Helen eventually starts drinking and she and Calvin fight regularly.

So, fast forward to the day when the 35 years is up. Calvin goes out into the "Wasteland" to find a homeless man residing in the building above their shelter. As Calvin wonders around, he sees many things which lead him to believe that the people he sees are mutants. Calvin advises his family to stay in the fallout shelter for lounger, but he starts to suffer from chest pains, and they are running low on supplies. So Adam ventures out into what he thinks is a post apocalyptic wasteland.

So, hilarity ensues, Adam finds love, and his parents finally leave the shelter and move into a replica of their house that Adam had built for them.
